chunk.content: Yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares), one species within the tuna label, is usually sold as steaks, cutlets or sliced as sashimi, with an average yield of 70-75%; only sashimi-grade fish should be served raw or rare.
chunk.source_quote: Usually sold as steaks, cutlets or sliced as sashimi. ... Always buy sashimi-grade fish if it is to be served raw or rare. ... Average yield is 70-75%.
